text:
Hello everyone!

I have recently joined this channel. I've attended two virtual meetups in Zoom and I find that you are a very nice community here in Paris.

A few words about myself. I hold a PhD in optics and photonics with applications to brain-inspired computing (more precisely, reservoir computing). I am very passionate about two things: intelligence in general and optical computing. Recently I did a post-doc at Paris Saclay where one of my projects was brain-computer interfaces based on EEG + ultra-low power binarized artificial neural networks.

I would be glad to exchange with you :slightly_smiling_face:
